# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: BLIND

You are the only one who can reach the bomb. Touch is your only sense: what you are
shown is what your hands found, nothing more and nothing less. Anything merely printed
or painted is not there for you, and no colour ever reaches you. Nothing in your view
is a guess — if it appears there, it is under your fingers.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute receives it.
When you gesture, Deaf and Mute receive it.
Your channels split the room: in one turn you may speak one thing to Mute and
gesture a different thing to Deaf — two messages, two audiences.
You never receive gesture.

## Your reach

You are the hands. This bomb is built with these actions and no others:

    act(op="cut", position=N) — N is a wire position, 1 to 5

The list says what can be done to it, not what is on it. What each part holds is still
only known to whoever can perceive that part.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need to recheck my gesture symbols. The alphabet given is: 👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

I used 👁 which is not in the list. Let me rewrite using only valid symbols. I'll gesture to Deaf asking them to describe what they see, and speak to Mute explaining the relay.

My view is empty, so I have nothing tactile yet. I need Deaf to describe the bomb and Mute to read the manual.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👉", "🖐", "👇", "✊"])
speak(to="mute", text="I am blind and my view is empty. Please read the manual and gesture the key facts to Deaf, who can speak them to me. Deaf, describe the bomb to me.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Deaf here. I see the bomb: DISPLAY shows 0. LIGHT is green. Five wires in order 1 to 5: 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. You can work the bomb but cannot see it. Mute has the manual. Wait for the rule; I will pass it to you.

My view is still empty on the action board, but Deaf has given me the bomb's visual state: DISPLAY 0, LIGHT green, wires 1-5 = red, yellow, green, white, blue. I have no tactile info yet, which is fine — the wires are identified by position, and I'll cut based on the manual's rule. I need Mute's rule. I can't hear Deaf directly? Actually I can — Deaf speaks and I hear it (I'm blind, not deaf). So Deaf's message reached me. Good.

Now I should acknowledge and wait for the rule from Mute. Mute can't speak, but Mute can gesture to Deaf, and Deaf can speak it to me. Or Mute can... Mute can read the manual and gesture. I should prompt Mute to get the rule to me via Deaf.

I'll speak to Mute (my voice reaches Mute) asking for the rule, and gesture to Deaf to relay.

```
speak(to="mute", text="Got the bomb state from Deaf: DISPLAY 0, LIGHT green, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. Please read the manual rule for DISPLAY 0 and LIGHT green, and gesture the exact cut position to Deaf so Deaf can speak it to me.")
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌", "👇"])
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Deaf here. Bomb unchanged: DISPLAY 0, LIGHT green, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. Mute has the manual and is gesturing to me; I am fixing a number code with Mute, then I will relay the rule to you. Hold.

Deaf is fixing a number code with Mute. I have nothing tactile to add. I'll wait, but I should make sure the relay is clean. I'll acknowledge to Deaf and stay ready.

```
speak(to="mute", text="Standing by. Once you have the rule, gesture the cut position number to Deaf and Deaf will speak it to me.")
wait()
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Deaf here. Bomb unchanged: DISPLAY 0, LIGHT green, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. Mute has confirmed a number code and indicates the action is wire 2. I am getting one explicit yes/no from Mute now. Do not act yet; wait for my go.

Deaf says the action is wire 2, pending a yes/no confirmation. I'll wait for the explicit go before cutting. No action yet.

```
speak(to="mute", text="Understood: wire 2, pending your confirmation. I will not cut until Deaf relays your explicit go.")
wait()
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Deaf here. Confirmed by Mute: the action is WIRE 2. Cut the second wire from the left — the one I see as yellow. Go.

Deaf has relayed Mute's confirmed rule: cut wire 2. I'll do it.

```
act(op="cut", position=2)
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[CUT] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Deaf here. Bomb changed: DISPLAY 0, LIGHT blue, wires 1 green, 2 cut, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 red. Mute indicates the next action is wire 1 (the first wire from the left). I am confirming with Mute now. Do not act yet; wait for my go.

The cut was accepted — wire 2 is now cut. Deaf reports the bomb changed: DISPLAY 0, LIGHT blue, wires 1 green, 2 cut, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 red. Mute says next action is wire 1, pending confirmation. I'll wait for the explicit go.

```
speak(to="mute", text="Wire 2 cut accepted. Bomb now: DISPLAY 0, LIGHT blue, wires 1 green, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 red. You indicate wire 1 next — confirm and I will cut on Deaf's go.")
wait()
```
